segments.text: BEholde, I ſende vnto you prophetes & wiſe men, and Scribes, and ſome of them ye ſhall kill & crucifye: and ſome of thē ſhall ye ſcourge in your Sinagogues, and perſecute them from citie to citie: that vpon you may come all the righteous bloud whiche hath ben ſhed vpon the earth, from the bloud of righteous Abel, vnto the bloud of Zacharias the ſōne of Barachias, whome ye ſlew betwene the tēple and the altare. Verely I ſay vnto you: al theſe thinges ſhal come vpon this generacion. O Ieruſalē, Ieruſalem, thou that killeſte the Prophetes and ſtoneſt them whiche are ſente vnto thee: howe often woulde I haue gathered thy children together, euen as the henne gathereth her chickens vnder her winges, and ye would not? Behold, your houſe is left vnto you deſolate. For I ſay vnto you, ye ſhall not ſee me hencefoorth, till that ye ſay: Bleſſed is he that cummeth in the name of the Lorde.
